notes.title: 1 day remaining! HYPE! FINAL PATCH READY!
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
Each hat has their own stats now:
[list][*]Bald head: Typical bald head.
[*]Carrot hat: 10% increased scroll speed.
[*]Watermelon hat: 25% chance to double collected watermelon.
[*]PineApple hat: +1 Heart
[*]Corn hat: 33% fruit score multiplier
[*]Onion hat: 25% chance to double collected Onion.
[*]Eggplant hat: 33% increased damage to bosses.
[*]Chilli pepper: 35% increased scroll speed.[/list]

[h1]Shop changes:[/h1]
[list][*]Every hat was worth 500 coins, now since hats does give you upgrades their cost will be balanced.
[*]Bald head: Free
[*]Carrot hat: 350
[*]Watermelon hat: 250
[*]PineApple hat: 750
[*]Corn hat: 750
[*]Onion hat: 250
[*]Eggplant hat: 1000
[*]Chilli pepper: 1500[/list]

[h1]Edits:[/h1]
[list][*]Translators special thanks will be shown on the credits page.
[*]There will be main menu random song enabled at the main menu now. There was silence if you were on the main menu, till u start any level.[/list]

[h1]Levels edits:[/h1]
[list][*]Watermelon looks like cactus won't spawn at the desert level cause it is too sketchy.[/list]

[h1]Vegan edits:[/h1]
[list][*]Now when you are are at the boss fight you won't shoot always, now you need to actually click, OR hold the left mouse button.
[*]Bosses now will have a 2 path's. First one is hardly predictable.[/list]

[h1]Small changes:[/h1]
[list][*]The game now has the icon with the carrot.[/list]
